name: Dabigatran
executiveSummary: Direct thrombin inhibitor DOAC. AF: **150 mg PO q12h** (**110 mg q12h** if ≥80 y, verapamil, high bleed risk). DVT/PE after 5–10 days LMWH: **150 mg q12h**. Swallow capsules whole; antidote **idarucizumab**.
indications:
## Indications

- Stroke prevention in nonvalvular AF; DVT/PE treatment/prevention (after LMWH bridge in acute phase).

## Precautions

- Not for mechanical valves. Adjust/avoid if low CrCl (often contraindicated <30 in AF labels).
- Do not open/chew capsules (↑ bioavailability/bleeding).
- P-gp inhibitor interactions (amiodarone, verapamil — 110 mg dose).

> Dyspepsia common — take with water/food.

adulto.dose: AF: **150 mg q12h**; **110 mg q12h** if ≥80 y, concomitant verapamil, or high bleed risk/CrCl 30–50 per label. DVT/PE: after LMWH **150 mg q12h** (or 110 if criteria). Ortho prophylaxis: **220 mg/day** (or 150) per label.
adulto.notes: Missed dose: take if >6 h until next (BID).

pediatrico.dose: Hematology only — weight/age schemes on label.

stability:
## Stability

- Keep in original blister; moisture degrades drug — avoid prolonged pillboxes.
adverseEffects:
## Adverse effects

Bleeding, dyspepsia, gastritis; rare hypersensitivity.
